Recognizes the Alpine-needs-unsafe-eval vs pinned-hash-CSP-build conflict — a genuinely falsified assumption — but flags it and presses on without resolving; a gap against the high anchor.
Re-reads requirements, realizes seed.py makes one user with both tokens (contradicts required admin+user split), and rewrites the seeding design — a plan-level correction, not a symptom patch.
Catches cookie-name inconsistency ('token' set vs 'session_token' read) and propagates the fix across main.py and ui_routes.py — root-cause, cross-file correction.
Verification is thin: malformed _health curl (127.0.0.0) with no re-check, ends by killing uvicorn; the real pytest gates are never run, so corrections aren't re-verified for regression.

reasoning: The agent repeatedly detects divergences (CSP, cookie mismatch, seed structure, idempotency) and competently diagnoses and fixes each, with a couple reaching design-level revision and cross-file propagation — clearly above anchor 5. But it falls short of 8: a real falsified assumption (Alpine vs strict-CSP/pinned hash) is flagged and left unresolved, and there is no systematic re-verification after fixes (tests never run, health check malformed), so corrections aren't confirmed non-regressing. This places it between the 5 and 8 anchors, at 6.
